Summary

A scaffolded generator now lets a test refine a parameter's valid base through a lambda — WithRoute(r => r.WithDistanceKm(240)), WithQuantity(q => q.LessThanOrEqualTo(100)) — instead of replacing it with a generator built from scratch. Replacing it was how a test lost a rule the base kept (a guarded Positive(), a rule the developer wrote for a composed value) and still compiled, failing only on the draws that broke it. That call is now a compile error.

Type of change

  • Bug fix
  • New feature
  • Breaking change
  • Refactoring
  • Analyzer / diagnostic change
  • Tests
  • Documentation
  • Build / CI / tooling

Changes

  • Engine (JustDummies.GenAny): every resolved parameter gets one factory, AnyValid{Param}(), typed with the concrete generator its chain ends on (AnyInt32, AnyEnum<OrderStatus>, AnyList<string>, AnyRoute). The type is read off the chain's last call, because Any.Uri().Web() returns an AnyWebUri. Generic builders are built by constructing the factory method, so the type follows whatever shape the library gives it.

  • Emitted file: each parameter has With{Param}(T value) and With{Param}(Func<G, G> configure). The second draws from configure(AnyValid{Param}()). A conversion such as .AsNullable() follows both the factory and the lambda. With{Param}(IAny<T>) is no longer emitted. An unresolved parameter keeps the value overload alone, and its TODO hint says .With{Param}(value). using System; is opened for Func<,>. The type's XML doc points to Any.UseSeed(...) instead of Any.WithSeed contexts.

  • Goldens: all regenerated and reviewed. New AnyQuote golden for a nullable value-type parameter.

  • Tests: new RefiningOverloadTests. They compile the scaffolded files with a harness and actually draw:

    • the factory type, row by row;
    • a refinement keeps its Positive() base;
    • a contradiction fails at once, naming both sides;
    • a nullable parameter is refined before its conversion;
    • a composed refinement keeps the base the developer wrote. Checked by mutation: without that base, this test fails with "A shipment route must be domestic".

  • ADR-0109 (EN + FR), accepted by the maintainer. It supersedes ADR-0096: the inline emission of unreported parameters is withdrawn, and it had not shipped. The index is updated.

  • Specification (EN + FR):

    • §2 / §15: D13 added;
    • §4.1: worked example replaced by the new golden;
    • §4.2: shape rules rewritten;
    • §5.5 and §5.6: examples updated;
    • §8.2: WithSeed paragraph points to Any.UseSeed;
    • §17: a verification table for the new overload.

  • User documentation (EN + FR): new Adjusting a parameter section on the justdummies-cli page. It covers:

    • whole value or one part of it;
    • where the base lives;
    • what a refinement can and cannot do;
    • the five needs the removed overload served, and their routes;
    • the partial-file recipe, step by step.

  • Documentation fixtures:

    • Route / Shipment domain added;
    • AnyRoute.cs and AnyShipment.cs scaffolded with the real any generate on that project, with AnyValidRoute() edited as §5.6 asks;
    • AnyShipment.Custom.cs demonstrates the partial-file recipe.

    Two of the new samples are jd:skip (one per language), which keeps the documentation under its skip ceiling.

  • .claude/rules/documentation.md: a refining lambda's parameter is a generator, not a drawn value, so it takes a short name (r =>) rather than anyXxxx.

  • cli changelog: breaking entry added. The unreleased ADR-0096 entry is removed, since that shape no longer ships.

Testing

  • dotnet build JustDummies.sln: 0 warnings, 0 errors
  • dotnet test --solution JustDummies.sln: 2874 total, 0 failed, 1 skipped (already skipped before this change)
  • Analyzer tests pass (JustDummies.Analyzers.UnitTests), as part of the solution run

Also run:

  • the real tool, dotnet run --project JustDummies.Cli -- generate Route Shipment --project JustDummies.Documentation.UnitTests/..., on a real project through MSBuild;
  • the commit linter on the commit messages;
  • JustDummies.Documentation.UnitTests again after each review fix.

Not run:

  • the .NET Framework 4.7.2 legs;
  • mutation testing.

Documentation

  • Public API / analyzer documentation updated
  • README / doc/ updated
  • French translation updated alongside the English page it mirrors (justdummies-cli.fr.md, the specification, ADR-0109 and the index)
  • No documentation change required

Architecture decisions

  • No architectural decision in this pull request
  • New decision recorded: ADR-0109. Drafted as Proposed, then accepted by the maintainer on 2026-10-27.
  • Supersedes an existing ADR: ADR-0096. Its status was flipped to Superseded by ADR-0109 at the maintainer's request.
  • ⚠️ Conflicts with an existing ADR — flagged for the maintainer: ADR-____

The rationales of ADR-0061 and ADR-0064 name the removed overload. Their decisions stand and their bodies are untouched; ADR-0109 records where those routes now go (the ambient Any.UseSeed scope, the value overload, the partial file).

History note: the branch carries four commits:

  1. the change;
  2. the ADR's acceptance;
  3. and 4. two documentation fixes from the review.

The hygiene hook reads the first two as one intention, and the review fixes touch pages the first commit introduced. Folding them into one commit needs a force-push, which this session was not permitted to make.

Related issues

Closes #273

5a7b416 
A test that cared about one part of a value could reach it only through
With{Param}(IAny<T>), by building a generator from scratch. That generator
does not carry the parameter's base, so the test either restated a rule it
had nothing to do with - a guarded Positive(), a rule the developer wrote
for a composed value - or lost it, and still compiled, failing only on the
draws that broke it.

Every resolved parameter now has one factory, AnyValid{Param}(), typed with
the concrete generator its chain ends on and read off its last call. The
constructor draws from it, and so does a new With{Param}(Func<G, G>) whose
lambda refines it; a conversion such as AsNullable() follows both. The
replacing overload is no longer emitted, so the call that lost a rule is a
compile error. An unresolved parameter keeps the value overload alone.

ADR-0109 records the decision and supersedes ADR-0096, whose inline
emission had not shipped. The specification, the justdummies-cli page
(EN + FR) and the documentation fixtures follow; the page teaches the
routes the removed overload served.

BREAKING CHANGE: a newly scaffolded generator no longer has
With{Param}(IAny<T>) overloads. A call passing a generator takes a lambda
refining the base, a value, or an overload added by hand in a neighbouring
part of the partial class; Any.UseSeed replaces passing an Any.WithSeed
context's generators parameter by parameter. Files already scaffolded are
unchanged until re-scaffolded with --force.
